summary: Feed s096_single to NDR is degraded due to VXLAN encapsulation: 18.2% of frames (501/2754) arrive inside VXLAN VNI 501, hiding inner traffic from inspection. All other visibility checks (duplicates, one-way, drops, overload, truncation, VLAN, encryption, oversize) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker is forwarding VXLAN-encapsulated traffic (VNI 501) without stripping the outer header. NDR is receiving the outer VXLAN/UDP/IP wrapper instead of the original inner Ethernet/IP frames.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR cannot parse inner L2-L7 headers and payload for 18.2% of traffic, reducing detection coverage for lateral movement and C2 inside the overlay. Correlation and payload analysis fail on encapsulated frames despite NDR needing full payload and both directions.

recommended_fix.why: Stripping VXLAN at the packet broker exposes the original inner frames so the NDR can inspect payload and headers with its existing parsers, restoring visibility for the 18.2% currently opaque without changing TAP/SPAN.
